title: Restriction of a padded tuple
statement: Let $a,r,M$ be natural numbers with $a\le r$, let $c$ assign an element of $\mathrm{Fin}(M)$ to each element of $\mathrm{Fin}(r)$, and let $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(a)$. The first component of the tuple obtained by splitting $c$ into its first $a$ coordinates and its remaining coordinates, evaluated at $i$, is $c(i)$, where $i$ is viewed in $\mathrm{Fin}(r)$ via the inclusion of the initial segment.
